result.threshold: Agent returns degraded response when dependencies are down
result.details: Implemented three circuit-breaker protected wrappers: mitre_attack_search_resilient (3 retries, 2s wait, MITRE fallback), enrich_ioc_resilient (3 retries, 2s wait, empty enrichment fallback), opencti_query_resilient (2 retries, 3s wait, empty threat intel fallback). Uses tenacity with retry_if_exception_type(httpx.HTTPStatusError) pattern. EAFP exception handling ensures graceful degradation.
